surface: Current Codex desktop chat using installed ChatNoir skill and helper

target.name: Workshop Prep Agent
target.kind: Separate publicly distributed TypeScript/Next.js web application

baseline.language_limit: JS/TS lexical dynamic-evaluation check, not a semantic security scanner

agent_workflow.method: Source review and actual route/helper invocations with bounded local Request streams

checks.target_specific_boundary_observations: Initial whole-body buffering reproduced locally; legitimate JSON control passed before and after the subsequent fix.

limitations: Not a blind or independent evaluation.
No memory-exhaustion attempt, oversized production request, live model generation or external database call.
Body cancellation verified with in-process Request streams; production smoke was read-only configuration.
Effective upstream limits and production denial-of-service impact are unverified.
Reused installed dependencies; selected versions matched the public lockfile.
Full local reports and raw traces were not uploaded.
No ChatNoir runtime change or new release version was required.

remediation.finding: CWE-400: JSON body fully buffered before size check
remediation.change: Incremental UTF-8 decoding and stream cancellation at the existing character limit

production.scope: read-only config smoke; production oversize requests not tested
